CGC Inc. is a leading marketer, manufacturer and distributor of gypsum wallboard products, interior finishing material and suspended acoustical ceilings. With locations around the world, CGC and USG have the resources, plants, products, and people to build walls, ceilings, and careers.

 CGC Inc. is currently recruiting a Quality Tester for our gypsum quarry in Little Narrows, NS! Reporting to the Mill, Shipping & Quality Manager, this is a permanent, full-time position currently operating on a day shift schedule. Rotating shift and weekend work may be required as operational needs evolve.

 Role & Responsibilities

• Perform all testing required for rock production and shipping

• Calibrate quality testing instruments

• Using various digital tools, monitor and communicate quality control information to mill and quarry supervision

• Determine plans prior to and during ship loading procedures

• Complete documentation and paperwork related to the ship loading process

• Participate in all safety, continuous improvement, and diversity, equity & inclusion activities as they arise

• Assist with ship loading and duties as needed

 What You Bring

• Previous experience performing testing in a lab environment is required with preference given to mining and / or manufacturing settings.

• Proficiency in the use of lab equipment and advanced computer applications is required.

• Excellent communication skills with ability to deal with crucial information timely and accurately.

• A track record of positive safety behaviors, attendance, attitude and work performance with a passion for learning new skills.

• High school diploma is required; post-secondary education is not necessary but nice to have.

 What We Offer

 CGC offers competitive base salaries and cash incentive awards, comprehensive benefits, and financial protection for employees and their families. Our Employee Group Benefits Plan (extended health care and dental care) begins on your first day of work!

• 4 weeks of paid vacation after 1 year of service

• Extended health care (including prescription drugs, vision, and paramedical professional services)

• Dental care (includes both preventative care and major dental work)

• Short-term and long-term disability

• Life insurance

• Retirement plan - contributory defined benefit plan

• Investment plan - defined contribution plan with options to contribute to a Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) and/or a non-registered savings plan.

• Incentive Plan - cash payments based on target achievement are earned quarterly or annually, depending upon the plan.

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Wellness Program offers fitness club memberships at a special reduced rate, health coaching, nutrition support, smoking cessation services, and much more.

• Rewards and Recognition Program

We understand the importance of balancing work and your personal life and will help you make your best contribution in both.

At CGC Inc. we go the distance to provide The Better Way. Delivering building solutions for customers worldwide is our goal. Relationships are our foundation. Integrity, Dependability and Innovation are the standards by which we live.
